subject: general
question:
A diver was swimming at a depth of -30 meters below sea level. She then ascended 18 meters towards the surface.

What is her new position relative to sea level?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial depth below sea level = −30 m

Movement (ascent) = +18 m

Final position = −30 + 18 = −12 m

The position is 12 meters below sea level.

**∴ Answer = 12 meters**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial position of the diver = 30 meters below sea level (−30 m)

Ascent distance = 18 meters (positive movement)

**Formula used:**

New Position = Initial Position + Upward Displacement

 
• Sea Level (0 m) 
• 
 Start: −30 m New Position: −12 m Ascent (+18 m) 
• Total Depth: 30 m 

**Calculations:**

The initial position is 30 meters below the surface, represented as −30.

⇒ New position = −30 + 18

⇒ New position = −12

⇒ The negative sign indicates it is below sea level, so the depth is 12 meters.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Integers and Sea Level

In mathematical problems, sea level is treated as the reference point zero (0). Positions above sea level are positive (+), and positions below sea level are negative (−).

Net Displacement

The final position is always the algebraic sum of the initial position and the changes. Displacement upward is added, while displacement downward is subtracted.

Absolute Value of Depth

The term 'depth' itself implies a distance below a surface. While the coordinate is −12, the depth is the absolute value |−12| = 12 meters.
